UNSAFE as designed. The dosage document for epilepsy states: 'Dosing recommendations for use of this drug in combination with gabapentin have not been evaluated and cannot be offered.' Gabapentin and pregabalin both bind the same α2δ subunit, so combining them is pharmacologically redundant with additive CNS depression, dizziness, somnolence, edema, and no established incremental benefit. Either switch to pregabalin monotherapy (cross-taper) or add a mechanistically distinct AED (e.g., lacosamide, lamotrigine).
